description:
Request that paused company-level sending be restored after fixing the cause. This is the supported remediation path for an account paused by the permanent-bounce rate limit - it is not a bypass and it never removes suppressions.

Intended for after the bad source (import, form, or integration) is actually fixed while permanent bounces remain suppressed. get_sending_status reports the current gate: for a paused workspace, resume only restores sending when `selfResume.canSelfResume` is true, which requires a hard-bounce pause reason, a cleared automated sender-health review, and no admin block. A workspace that is already active succeeds as a no-op with `resumed: false`; any other blocked state needs a support review, and the error names which one.

listSanitizationConfirmed: true is required and represents the user's confirmation that the remediation is done; it is recorded on the account's audit trail as their statement that the list is clean. On success, sending is restored, the bounce watermark resets so the rate is recalculated from later sends, and the service attempts to requeue paused campaigns plus due sequence steps. The response message contains support guidance if part of that queue handoff is temporarily unavailable.

Requires the companies:manage scope and owner or admin access to the company.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

listSanitizationConfirmed.description: Must be true. Confirms the user has fixed the source of the invalid addresses and left every permanent bounce suppressed. Recorded on the account audit trail.

name: resume_sending

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `resume_sending` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

metricsWindow.description: Enforcement watermarks after the resume. bounceResetAt moves to now, so the paused rate is recalculated from later sends.

remediation.description: Steps to keep sending healthy after the resume, plus supportEmail and docsUrl.

resumed.description: True when this call restored sending. False when sending was already active.

selfResume.description: Self-resume state after the request, including the automated review status and how many gates remain.

status.description: Sending state after the request. active on success.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
